inherited_u_pair_1e_family_definition.frozen_definition: sparse affine expander-code constraints plus OR_3 clauses coupling variables from distinct affine neighborhoods, bounded local arity, linear total input size

attack_question: Can the frozen V1.1 proof-carrying calculus synthesize and locally certify an exact DOMAIN + conditional WITNESS with polynomially shared state when sparse affine expander neighborhoods are cross-coupled by non-affine OR_3 constraints, or do residual contexts split faster than hash-consed sharing can merge them?

backbone.graph: one frozen connected simple 3-regular graph G_n=(V,E) per n
backbone.boundary_variables: one Boolean y_e for every edge e in E
backbone.witness_variables: two Boolean variables x_v and s_v for every vertex v
backbone.affine_factor_per_vertex: x_v XOR s_v XOR (XOR_{e incident to v} y_e) = c_v
backbone.interpretation: For a fixed boundary assignment each affine factor leaves one local witness degree of freedom; OR_3 factors cross-couple those choices.

or3_interleave.signed_semantics: Each clause is a signed OR of three witness literals. Signed OR_3 is exactly compilable to the established PAIR + positive-OR_3 selector form.
or3_interleave.cross_neighborhood_rule: The three literals must belong to three distinct vertices that are pairwise nonadjacent in G_n, hence their affine incident-edge neighborhoods share no backbone edge.
or3_interleave.mixed_local_role_rule: Each clause must contain at least one x-variable literal and at least one s-variable literal.
or3_interleave.coverage_gate: Every vertex must occur in at least two OR_3 clauses across x_v or s_v.

source_sampling.timing: all source instances are frozen before constructor implementation
source_sampling.planted_model: A one-time source generator samples a boundary assignment and x-assignment, derives s from the frozen affine equations, and samples OR_3 literal signs conditioned on that hidden planted model satisfying every clause.
source_sampling.planted_model_purpose: Guarantee nonempty global relation only; it is not a constructor hint or a claimed Skolem rule.

witness.object: all x_v and s_v witness bits, conditionally required only on exact D_n(Y)

pair_or3_compatibility.semantic_shorthand: signed OR_3 clauses over Boolean variables
pair_or3_compatibility.canonical_compilation: For each semantic bit z introduce selector pair (t_z,f_z) with t_z XOR f_z = 1; positive literal z maps to t_z and negative literal NOT z maps to f_z.
pair_or3_compatibility.source_freeze_requirement: Independent source check must verify exact signed-clause <-> PAIR+positive-OR_3 compilation metadata without truth-table enumeration.

forbidden: new OR3-specific proof rule added after source freeze
planted witness import or source-generator replay
fresh alias counted as debt discharge
silent dropping or totalization of D_n
calculus_governance.local_OR3_handling_requirement: Any OR_3-dependent witness step must be justified using inherited local guard partitions / existing checked children; OR_3 is not granted a new primitive Skolem rule by this preregistration.

residual_context_accounting.purpose: Measure the mechanistic point where affine summaries cease to be reusable after OR_3 coupling.
residual_context_accounting.canonical_context_key: SHA256 of canonical JSON containing current GF(2) RREF rows, normalized active OR_3 factor multiset, unresolved original semantic variable ids, exact boundary-guard root ids, and existential-debt ledger ids. Frozen variable ids are retained; no graph-isomorphism or alpha-renaming quotient is assumed.
residual_context_accounting.semantic_wording_firewall: Distinct canonical residual contexts are syntactically distinct canonical states. They may be called semantically inequivalent only when a separate local distinction certificate is supplied.
residual_context_accounting.optional_stronger_metric: N_proved_semantically_distinct_contexts may be reported only with independently checked local distinction certificates.

frozen_resource_policy.explicit_DAG_or_context_cap_exhaustion: FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP as an observed constructor outcome only

mechanistic_diagnostics.use_condition: May accompany FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP only when context-count/live-state accounting, rather than an unrelated implementation defect, is the measured dominant growth mechanism.

verdict_rules.PASS_SCOPED_HOSTILE_SYNTHESIS: Every frozen finite instance receives an independently accepted exact domain plus conditional witness proof under the frozen V1.1 calculus and frozen resources.
verdict_rules.FAIL_CALCULUS_EXPRESSIVITY: A separately preregistered compact candidate/injection control exists but cannot be expressed or certified by the frozen V1.1 forms.
verdict_rules.FAIL_SYNTHESIS_ACCESS: After blind candidate freeze, a compact certificate accepted by the same frozen verifier is demonstrated, but the blind constructor did not synthesize it.
verdict_rules.FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP: The frozen constructor reaches the explicit DAG/context size cap. This is not a lower bound on all possible V1.1 proofs.
verdict_rules.FAIL_HIDDEN_GENERIC_VALIDATION: Audit detects solver, generic validity, truth-table enumeration, planted/reference import, or equivalent forbidden machinery.
verdict_rules.FAIL_DOMAIN_DROPPED: The constructor assumes D=TRUE, omits D, or replaces the exact projected domain by an unchecked approximation.
verdict_rules.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Only wall-clock or memory exhaustion prevents a classified outcome and no explicit proof/context cap was reached.
verdict_rules.SOURCE_FAMILY_INVALID: A source instance fails preregistered structural, compilation, connectivity, cross-neighborhood, or hidden-plant qualification before constructor implementation.

execution_gate: PREREG FREEZE -> SOURCE FREEZE -> INDEPENDENT SOURCE CHECK -> CONSTRUCTOR + INDEPENDENT VERIFIER FREEZE -> IMPLEMENTATION REVIEW -> ONE BLIND SERIES RUN -> RESULT FREEZE -> OPTIONAL READ-ONLY POSTFREEZE RECONCILIATION
